messages:
erin: opened PR to update Alba7b model card: lower max_sequence to 4096, clarify embedding chunking and streaming support. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/978
paul: noted. on streaming: does q3_0 support server-side streaming or is it a decode fallback? current table says 'yes' but ops reported a fallback.
erin: good catch. ops confirmed q3_0 uses a decode fallback for contexts >2k which disables streaming. i'll change the compat table to: 'streaming: fp16 native; q3_0 streaming for <=2k, fallback >2k'.
meera: can we add a tiny SDK snippet showing the recommended pattern with `max_context` hint and a guard for `max_new_tokens`? e.g. `client.responses.create({ model: 'alba7b-q3_0', input, max_new_tokens: 128, stream: true })`
erin: yes i'll add that under "Examples" and explicitly set `max_new_tokens` to avoid runaway output.
paul: bench request: include tokens/sec @ batch1 and p95 latency on A100. ops provided CSV from 2026-01-27. add link and a short note: "performance degrades significantly past 4k".
erin: adding table + raw CSV link. infra-bot: preview built for PR 978 -> https://deploys.redwood-internal/preview/978 (expires in 7d)
meera: editorial nit: change "supports embeddings" to "embeddings via chunking for inputs >2048" and add small example for chunking calls.
erin: done. also updated catalog JSON: catalog/models/alba7b.json -> max_sequence: "4096", supported_variants: ["fp16","q3_0"], streaming_note: "fp16 native; q3_0 partial (<=2k)"
paul: i'll review and approve if wording and benches look good.
erin: thanks — aiming to merge before docs cut.
